facts.claim: Japan's International Tourist Tax, the departure tax, is ¥3,000 per person from 1 July 2026, collected in the price of your ticket.

sources.title: JNTO: Japan's International Tourist Tax is increasing

facts.note: Secondary sources say tickets issued by 30 June 2026 keep the old rate; confirm with the National Tax Agency before stating it. The three related-reading cards take their text from add_internal_links.ARTICLES.

facts.claim: Japan's International Tourist Tax was ¥1,000 per person from its introduction in January 2019 until 30 June 2026.

sources.title: JNTO: Japan's International Tourist Tax is increasing

facts.note: Our guide's summary line kept this figure until 4 October 2026 (corrections.html).
